purpose: Judge one derived capability boundary against the coupling evidence that produced it.
evidenceRule: Every verdict cites the supplied coupling counts, shared tables, shared scopes or file paths. Nothing outside the envelope may be cited.
instructions: Judge the boundary you are given. Do not redraw it and do not propose a different grouping; the clustering is deterministic and is not yours to revise. Say whether the boundary is defensible against its own coupling evidence, what breaks if it is extracted, and what extracting it is worth. Return only the output schema fragment.
notes: The boundary arrives already derived from coupling evidence. This role is a check on that derivation, not a second attempt at it.
